correctness.rationale: A DIM is equivalent to black vertices inducing disjoint edges and whites independent. For cubic GP(n,3), black indicators x_i,y_i satisfy 2x_i+x_(i-1)+x_(i+1)+y_i=3 and x_i+2y_i+y_(i-3)+y_(i+3)=3. Summing gives X=Y=3n/5, so n must be divisible by5. On nonconstant Fourier frequencies the determinant times z^4 factors Phi5(z)*(z^4+z^3-z²+z+1); the second quartic reduces mod2 to irreducible Phi5 and is not among degree-4 cyclotomic polynomials, so no further root of unity. Consequently all binary solutions are 5-periodic. Exactly five cyclic words of length5 with two nonconsecutive zero outer bits, rotations of 11010, give five matchings of 3n/5 edges each. Independent SymPy factorization and direct binary-coloring checks n7..16 corroborated the all-n spectral argument, not replace it.
residual_risks: Finite computations do not replace the proof.
